description: CBS table2.8: annual-average2023 national Jews and Others born abroad, by25 published countries/groups and8 age bands. Not Census2022, arrivals or city data. Russia/Ukraine stay within SU; US/Canada within NA_OC; source dashes are not invented zeros.

age.description: Published age band with inclusive endpoints, or all ages. Default all. Source dashes remain missing values; percentages use the national total for the selected age band.

country.description: Published country/group ID, for example FR, ET, SU or NA_OC; all returns every group. Russia/Ukraine are grouped as SU and US/Canada as NA_OC; unavailable splits return an error.

region.description: Published source region to filter; default all. A selected country must belong to this region. The national share denominator is unchanged.

year.description: Reference year of the annual-average population estimate. Only 2023 is available; separate from Census2022.

name: get_birth_country_population
